description: This Java class 'DeviceChooser' provides a UI component for selecting Android devices/emulators within an IDE environment, managing device detection, filtering, and display in a table with sorting and selection capabilities.

classes.name: DeviceChooser
classes.description: Main class providing a device selection UI component with device detection, filtering, and display functionalities.

classes.name: MyDeviceTableModel
classes.description: Table model for displaying device information in the device chooser table.

classes.name: DeviceNameRenderer
classes.description: Custom cell renderer for displaying device names and icons.

classes.name: LaunchCompatibilityRenderer
classes.description: Custom cell renderer for displaying launch compatibility status.

methods.name: DeviceChooser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the device chooser component with configuration parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the device list and selection based on provided serials.

methods.name: updateTable
methods.description: Fetches and sorts connected devices, updating the display if changes are detected.

methods.name: refreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes the device display table, maintaining selection state.

methods.name: getFilteredDevices
methods.description: Returns devices filtered by the provided condition.

methods.name: getSelectedDevices
methods.description: Returns currently selected devices based on table selection.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the device table UI.
